_note: The rules every episode of the German prehistoric channel is built to. Code reads them from here (core/channel.py); changing a rule is a reviewed change to this file, through dev -> smoke -> main.

motion.living_species: real video only (Wikimedia Commons, NOAA, Pixabay video; PD, CC0 or CC BY; credited in the description)
motion.extinct_species: FLUX frames; the best of them animated with LTX-Video image-to-video on Kaggle

reject: modern animals in a prehistoric scene

never: What If build days Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri/Sat before 17:30 UTC

llm_quota._note: Free daily allowances of this channel's own keys (GEMINI_API_KEY_PH, GROQ_API_KEY_PH). Google publishes no free-tier table (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits points to AI Studio); the Gemini numbers are cautious estimates from what this channel saw on 28-29.10 (flash spent after a handful of requests; flash-lite took 180+ in a day) until a 429 states the real quotaValue (core/gemini.py logs it). Groq: console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits for openai/gpt-oss-120b (the page does not say whether these are the free or the developer plan's). Days end at midnight Pacific time for both.
